detail: Octavian, Antony and Lepidus form the Second Triumvirate to divide power. Antony takes Gaul, Lepidus takes Spain, and Octavian takes Africa, Sicily and Sardinia.
label: November 43 BCE
title: The Second Triumvirate
tldr: Octavian, Antony and Lepidus share out power and kill their enemies, Cicero among them.
